question: For research paper reading, how can we improve the automatic generation of related work sections for scientific papers with the help of language models?

ingredients.name: answer_critical_0
ingredients.criterion: The answer identifies photonic crystal surfaces/structures as the core means of efficiently recovering emitted fluorescence, enabling high signal-to-noise biological detection.
examples: Photonic structures for efficient recovery of emitted light

ingredients.name: answer_critical_1
ingredients.criterion: The answer explains that enhancement arises from spectral and spatial coupling of fluorophore emission to leaky eigenmodes of the photonic crystal, combining high-intensity near fields with strong coherent scattering and resonant redirection of emitted radiation.
examples: Spectral and spatial coupling of QD emission with leaky eigenmodes

ingredients.name: answer_critical_2
ingredients.criterion: The answer quantifies fluorescence enhancement of up to 108x for colloidal quantum dots on visible-wavelength 2D photonic crystal slabs, relative to an unpatterned surface.
examples: Fluorescence intensity enhanced by a factor of up to 108 for QDs

Comparison against QDs on an unpatterned surface

ingredients.name: answer_critical_3
ingredients.criterion: The answer describes coupling the photonic crystal to an underlying Fabry-Perot-type cavity via a gold mirror reflector, yielding a further 6x signal-to-noise improvement for surface-adsorbed fluorophore-tagged biomolecules.
examples: Gold mirror beneath the PC forming a Fabry-Perot cavity
6x SNR increase for a dye-labeled polypeptide
Cavity coupling as a fundamentally new enhancement route

ingredients.name: answer_critical_4
ingredients.criterion: The answer demonstrates translation into a working assay: a fluorescence sandwich immunoassay detecting TNF-alpha with over 20-fold signal enhancement.
